headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 11, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays secured a thrilling 2-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Simeon Woods Richardson earning the win and Louis Varland securing the save. The New York Mets took down the Atlanta Braves in an 8-5 win, led by Brett Baty's home run and four RBIs. The Minnesota Twins secured a 5-9 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Josh Bell leading the Orioles' offense.

Injuries continue to impact teams, with notable players out due to injuries. The Los Angeles Dodgers transferred Blake Treinen to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. The Boston Red Sox transferred Isiah Kiner-Falefa to the 60-day injured list. The New York Yankees placed Kervin Castro on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 10, 2026, due to right elbow neuritis. The Toronto Blue Jays placed Jameson Taillon on the 15-day injured list due to right forearm tendinits.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including the Miami Marlins trading Jacob Berry to the Kansas City Royals. The Philadelphia Phillies traded Seth Johnson to the Athletics for Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins also traded Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Brandan Bidois, Brian Sanchez, and Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for Connor Norby and Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Red Sox in Thrilling Match**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 2-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Simeon Woods Richardson earning the win and Louis Varland securing the save.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Braves in Thrilling 8-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured an 8-5 win over the Atlanta Braves, with Brett Baty leading the offense with a home run and four RBIs.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles in 5-9 Thriller**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 5-9 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Josh Bell leading the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Dean Kremer pitched 7 strong innings for the Orioles, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Phillies Edge Cardinals in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a hard-fought 6-5 win over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Andrew Painter earning the win.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians in Thrilling 4-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a hard-fought win against the Cleveland Guardians, outscoring them 6-4. Impact hitters for the Tigers included Steven Kwan and Chase DeLauter, while Jo Adell and Kevin McGonigle also made notable contributions.

top_news.title: **Marlins Sweep Pirates in Two-Game Series**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins took a two-game sweep over the Pittsburgh Pirates, winning 0-2 in the final game. Esteury Ruiz and Eury Pérez were key contributors for the Marlins.

top_news.title: **Treinen Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers right-handed pitcher Blake Treinen has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. This move comes after he was initially placed on the 15-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire 1B Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their lineup with the addition of 1B Jacob Berry, acquired in a trade. Berry joins the Royals after being previously affiliated with another team.
